bayts.text: I have given into the possession of the most excellent of mankind (Muḥammad) that from which glad tidings never cease,
and He has spread for me His blessing, and led me with generosity.
The benefit of the chosen Prophet has driven toward others than me what one guards against,
and has led me, with the fear of Allah, as I headed for the Sanctuary.
It gladdens the best of the Messengers, with the most beautiful Companions
and his perfected Family, the serving of him with my pen.
The reward of the beautiful has come to meet me in the service of the effacer of obscurity (al-Māḥī, Muḥammad),
and my services incline to him, (I being) freed from pain.
I have given all of myself into the possession of Aḥmad for years, and he has led to me the arts (of knowledge),
and has guarded me from moaning and from what draws sickness.
Toward others than me (is driven) the falsehood of the heart; my speech does not tend to doubt,
and Allah has veiled my secret and guarded me from punishments.
The tongue of my remembrance, with gratitude, has pleased my God, the Appreciative,
and reproof does not come toward me, and I am not the accused.
Toward me my Sovereign has led the removal of the darknesses:
I illumine the heart of the wayfarer with the manifest and the hidden.
My Lord has made my foot firm through the Chosen, the Foremost,
and has guarded me from regret and from what draws the darknesses.
I have banished Iblīs, the accursed, through Allah, my Lord, the Helper,
toward another direction than mine; and Allah, through me, helps whoever seeks learning.
My writing leads the disciple (al-murīd) to the Able, the Everlasting, the Willing (Al-Murīd),
driving away every rebel (marīd) toward others than the one taught (by Him).
Our Prophet has effaced harm, (turning it) toward others than my person, and peril,
and the sparks do not come toward me, by the guarding of my Lord, the Most Generous.
